title: Consistent Flowers
description: Makes that flowers and grass are always in the middle of the block!
body:
### What is the Consistent Flowers mod? 🌿
Ever noticed how flowers and grass in Minecraft are slightly shifted to the side of a block? Although it adds some "natural" variety, it can be a real pain for people who love symmetry and precise.

This mod will remove the visual offset from these blocks, so they will be perfectly centered.

## Key Features:
* Aesthetically Precise: Perfect for formal gardens, modern builds, and organized farms.

* Performs Well: Extremely lightweight with no impact on your FPS.

## Compatibility:
Works with most vanilla plants including:
* Dandelions, Poppies, and all other flowers.
* Short Grass and Ferns.

## Requirements

* **Java 21** or higher
* **Fabric 0.16.9** or higher
* **Minecraft 1.21.11** (**26.1** is currently **not supported**)
